name: Home Assistant — Locks & Doors
description: A security-focused overview of every lock.* entity plus door / window / garage / opening binary_sensors. Stateful kind glyphs (ph-lock ↔ ph-lock-open, ph-door ↔ ph-door-open, etc.) communicate state via icon rather than text colour alone; unsecured rows wear a terracotta wash + an 'unsecured for Xm' timer chip. Auto-discovers entities — nothing to configure beyond the label and which kinds of openings to include.

cell_options.name: entities
cell_options.label: Entities to show (blank = auto-discover locks + door/window sensors)
